decisions: owner 2026-11-17 09:48: D1-D5, D7-D12 as recommended; D6 replaced: bots never play the Sluaghbinder (docs/ERA-BUILDS-1.2.md)
estimates: every share and every weight is an estimate from 2002-2003 forum posts (European servers); spec points come from dated posts unless 'change' says they were trimmed or filled ('posted' keeps the posts' points, 'changeBasis' says what the change rests on)
points: a build fits when a level 50 player of the class can pay for it: every level of every line, less a class's 'autotrain' lines up to level 12 (free for a player, 77 points a line); every build is fully trained: 'pointsLeft' buys no further level in any of its lines
sources: posted points: dated FreddysHouse posts of 2002-2003 ('sources', 'sourceDates'); 'wayback': what the Wayback scrape of 2026-11-13 holds for the build (site, page, capture date), empty when nothing does

Sluaghbinder.rule: bots never play the custom class, in any edition (owner 2026-11-17): no share, no builds; players keep it in the 0.37b edition
